entities.label: Person
entities.summary: His Excellency, The Most Reverend, Mons. Don. Héctor Rafael Rodríguez Rodríguez, M.S.C. is a Dominican prelate of the Catholic Church and professed member of the Missionaries of the Sacred Heart. He is metropolitan archbishop of Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Santiago de los Caballeros since October 2023. He previously served as Bishop of La Vega (2015-2023).
